==== Choosing JWT Validation, OIDC Discovery, or Opaque Introspection
+Step-up authentication rejects tokens whose authentication context does not meet the required
+security level, prompting the client to re-authenticate with stronger assurance. Configure
+`required-acr` and/or `max-auth-age-seconds` on the validation profile to enforce step-up:
+# Require re-authentication if the user authenticated more than 1 hour ago
+When a token fails the step-up check, the HTTP response includes a `WWW-Authenticate` challenge
+client can redirect the user to re-authenticate at the appropriate assurance level. Both options
+apply to JWT and opaque token introspection validation paths. Both options are off by default;
